registeredPrincipalDesign.method: WebAuthn ES256 + required user verification; trusted operator invitation linked to existing active employee ID
registeredPrincipalDesign.syncedPasskeys: Supported by verifier; not claimed to be hardware-bound
registeredPrincipalDesign.scope: One malicious enrolled principal cannot gain additional bcrypt slots using extra devices or NAT changes. Four compromised registered principals can occupy all global slots; two can occupy existing QA pool. Not absolute availability or DDoS protection.
registeredPrincipalDesign.operatorVerification: Human identity check and secure invitation delivery required; verification_ref is an audit pointer, not automatic proof
registeredPrincipalDesign.recovery: Concrete same-transaction credential->token_hash binding; recovery/revoke requires trusted scoped Core invalidation, exact true acknowledgement or rollback. Public/QA adapters preserve sibling on credential revoke and revoke all same-principal sessions on verified recovery. No legacy-unbound per-device guesses.
registeredPrincipalDesign.rollout: Pre-enroll and verify employee device support before cutover. Remain disabled until all affected legitimate users have an approved enrollment/recovery route. No password-only parallel bypass after activation.
remaining: Cloud least-privilege RPC install and rollback proof
Android Credential Manager or compatible WebView/RP integration and reviewed PUBLIC cert/DAL
Bounded multi-principal threat model and measured QA service latency/availability
registeredPrincipalDesign.providerIsolation: Real WebAuthn/invitation capability verified before distributed one-per-principal provider reservation. 5sec expiry, exact-nonce release required before further work, no DB connection over provider wait. Global preflight cap released only after durable reservation.
